about.title: The Turkish Riviera, Curated With Care
about.subtitle: {{brand}} presents a hand-picked collection of private yacht escapes and signature journeys across Türkiye, designed for guests who value privacy, comfort, and detail.
about.story1: {{brand}} was created to show the Turkish Riviera the way locals who love it experience it: quiet coves reached by private yacht, sunrise balloons over Cappadocia, and cities layered with millennia of history. Every experience in our collection is selected and checked by our own team. We present nothing we would not book ourselves.
about.story2: Behind the brand stands {{agency}}, a licensed travel agency based in Antalya. {{brand}} operates as its online sales and marketing channel; reservations, sales, and payment transactions are handled by the agency, so every booking is backed by a licensed operator.

curated.title: Curated Collection
curated.desc: A short, deliberate list of experiences, each one personally selected rather than an endless catalogue.
